title: CKnowEdit: A New Chinese Knowledge Editing Dataset for Linguistics, Facts, and Logic Error Correction in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing knowledge editing success rates natively in Chinese versus a cross-lingual approach (translating Chinese data to English, editing the English target, and evaluating the translated Chinese output) to demonstrate the Anglo-centric bias of current LLMs and editing techniques.

Evaluating the performance of knowledge editing methods on uniquely Chinese culture-laden facts, ancient poetry, idioms, and language-specific logic traps to expose the models' limitations in non-Western, culturally-grounded linguistic competencies.
